name: rungic-flatpak-gl
description:
The phone's GPU for Flatpak apps
This project's Mesa (KGSL, Freedreno, Zink, Turnip) built against the Freedesktop 25.08 runtime
as the GL extension org.freedesktop.Platform.GL.rungic, which the session selects with
FLATPAK_GL_DRIVERS (docs/49). The runtime's GL.default has no KGSL driver: apps rendered
with llvmpipe on the CPU.
